scope: Review every strict bound point and every later unscoped box at the frozen early and late observations. Reviewers receive only the original-object description, exact numeric span, and observed prefix excerpt. They do not receive final delivery, labels, arithmetic checks, oracle outputs, or information about whether a point was rejected.
decisions: BOUND when the exact number is a committed original objective; UNKNOWN for insufficient binding, tentative or changed reasoning; WRONG_OBJECT only when evidence positively assigns the number to a different quantity or threshold.
authority: Strict primary binding and gate remain unchanged. Independent definite WRONG_OBJECT on a strict authorized rejection counts as a verified false authorization. Independent sensitivity can bind additional original claims but cannot retrofit strict triggers or GPU eligibility.
evidence: Exact source span and reviewer output hashes. No quotes or original text are included in the public judgments.
